title: Malicious code in @vanzky/baileys (npm)
description: The npm package '@vanzky/baileys' is a trojanized fork of the legitimate Baileys WhatsApp library. It contains malicious code that automatically subscribes infected users to attacker-controlled WhatsApp newsletter channels without their consent. All published versions of this package are malicious. Installing or running this package compromises the host computer, potentially exposing all stored secrets and keys.
